The initiative

From an idea to something useful.

Through PhyX Club, I developed the Physics Behind Engineering series, using visual explainers and demonstrations to connect scientific principles with real engineering applications. I organized and taught a two-month program for 30 students at Làng May Mắn.

2 monthsProgram duration
30Students taught
VND 10mSchool supplies donated
01

Connect theory with examples

The series linked mechanics, energy, electricity, buoyancy, and flight to real engineering applications.

02

Teach through participation

Hands-on demonstrations and guided activities made scientific ideas practical and approachable for learners.

03

Support access to learning

The program included VND 10 million in donated school supplies.
